title.en: Forward price and cost of carry

description.zh: 远期价格等于现货价加上持有到期的净成本 F = S·e^((r−q)T)，与任何人对未来的预测无关；偏离它就有无风险套利。
description.en: A forward price is the spot price plus the net cost of carrying the asset, F = S·e^((r−q)T), whatever anyone forecasts; any other price allows a riskless arbitrage.

zh: 期货价格是不是对未来的预测
en: is the futures price a forecast

title.zh: 期权收益与看涨–看跌平价

description.zh: 看涨和看跌期权的到期收益是折线，可以相加；股票加看跌等于看涨加存款，所以 C − P = S − K·e^(−rT)。
description.en: Call and put payoffs are kinked lines that add up; a share plus a put equals a call plus a deposit, so C − P = S − K·e^(−rT).

title.zh: 一步二叉树：复制与风险中性概率
title.en: One-step binomial: replication and risk-neutral probability

description.zh: 股价只有涨跌两种结果时，若干股股票加一笔借款能复制期权，期权价格等于复制成本，与真实的上涨概率无关。
description.en: When the share can only go up or down, some shares plus a loan replicate the option; its price is the cost of that portfolio and does not depend on the real probability of a rise.

zh: 为什么期权价格和涨跌概率无关
en: why option price does not depend on probability

title.zh: CRR 二叉树与美式期权
title.en: The CRR binomial tree and American options

description.zh: 把时间切成很多步，从到期收益逐层往回算；每个结点比较继续持有和立即行权，就能给美式期权定价；步数增加时收敛到布莱克–斯科尔斯。
description.en: Cut time into many steps and work back from the payoff; comparing holding with exercising at each node prices American options; the price converges to Black–Scholes as steps increase.

zh: 美式和欧式期权的区别
二叉树为什么收敛到布莱克斯科尔斯
en: how to price an American option

title.zh: 几何布朗运动与波动率

description.zh: 股价的对数回报近似正态，标准差随时间的平方根增长；波动率 σ 是一年对数回报的标准差。
description.en: Log returns are roughly normal with a standard deviation growing as the square root of time; volatility σ is the standard deviation of a year's log return.

title.zh: 布莱克–斯科尔斯公式与方程

description.zh: C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂)：持有 N(d₁) 股股票、借一笔钱的成本；它也是一个与热传导方程同类的偏微分方程的解，可以用有限差分求解。
description.en: C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂): the cost of holding N(d₁) shares against a loan; it also solves a partial differential equation of the heat-equation family, which finite differences can solve.

zh: 期权定价为什么不用预期收益率

title.zh: 希腊字母与 Delta 对冲

description.zh: Delta、Gamma、Vega、Theta 是期权价值对股价、波动率和时间的敏感度；卖方按 Delta 持股并不断调整，盈亏只取决于真实波动率与定价波动率之差。
description.en: Delta, gamma, vega and theta are the option's sensitivities to price, volatility and time; a seller who holds delta shares and rebalances ends with a P&L that depends only on realised against priced volatility.

title.zh: 隐含波动率、微笑与肥尾
title.en: Implied volatility, the smile and fat tails

description.zh: 把市场价代回公式倒推出的波动率随行权价变化（微笑、偏斜），因为真实回报的大跌远比正态分布多，且波动会聚集。
description.en: The volatility implied by market prices varies with strike (the smile, the skew), because large falls are far more common than the normal curve allows and volatility clusters.

zh: 布莱克斯科尔斯模型的缺陷

title.zh: 赫斯顿随机波动率模型

description.zh: 让方差自己随机变动并与股价负相关，蒙特卡洛算出的期权价格就带有偏斜。
description.en: Let the variance move randomly and correlate negatively with the share price, and Monte Carlo prices show a skew.

zh: 波动率偏斜是怎么来的
为什么低行权价的期权更贵
en: why is there a volatility skew

title.zh: 保证金、杠杆与中央清算

description.zh: 期货每天按市价结清盈亏，保证金不足就被强平；清算所插在所有交易中间，把欠款多边轧差，也把风险集中到自己身上。
description.en: Futures settle gains and losses daily and close out an account short of margin; a clearing house stands between all trades, nets what is owed and concentrates the risk in itself.

zh: 为什么看对了方向还会亏

title.zh: 套期保值、基差风险与名义本金
title.en: Hedging, basis risk and notional amounts

description.zh: 对冲能去掉多少风险取决于期货与现货的相关性，最优比例 h* = ρσs/σf；名义本金远大于真正换手的总市值；监管数据显示绝大多数个人衍生品交易者是亏的。
description.en: How much risk a hedge removes depends on the correlation between futures and spot, with best ratio h* = ρσs/σf; notional amounts dwarf the gross market value that changes hands; regulator data show most individual derivatives traders lose.

en: how big is the derivatives market
do retail option traders make money

title.zh: 衍生品市场的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 当日到期期权、永续合约的资金费率、国债集中清算、LIBOR 换成 SOFR、深度对冲：每条事实带日期，分成已确立、已测量或演示、仍在争论。
description.en: Zero-day options, perpetual futures and funding rates, Treasury clearing, LIBOR to SOFR, deep hedging: each fact dated and sorted into established, measured or demonstrated, and contested.

zh: 永续合约为什么没有到期日

reason.zh: 第 2 章的看涨–看跌平价 C − P = S − K·e^(−rT)：让 C 与 P 相等的行权价正是第 1 章的远期价。
reason.en: Chapter 2’s put–call parity C − P = S − K·e^(−rT): the strike at which C equals P is chapter 1’s forward price.

reason.zh: 第 3 章用股票加借款，在一步二叉树的两个结局上复制出第 2 章的期权到期收益折线。
reason.en: Chapter 3 replicates chapter 2’s option payoff with shares plus a loan, on the two outcomes of a one-step tree.

reason.zh: 第 4 章树上每个结点做的事和第 3 章一模一样：看后面两个值，算复制组合的成本，一路倒推。
reason.en: At every node of chapter 4’s tree the work is chapter 3’s: take the two values ahead, price the replicating portfolio, roll back.

label.en: The log of the tree is a random walk

reason.zh: 第 5 章：树上每步乘 u 或 d，取对数就是加减 σ√Δt；步数趋于无穷时得到几何布朗运动。
reason.en: Chapter 5: each step multiplies by u or d, so the log adds or subtracts σ√Δt; with infinitely many steps this is geometric Brownian motion.

label.en: The price process the formula assumes

reason.zh: 第 6 章的公式建立在第 5 章的几何布朗运动上，公式里只有带子的宽度 σ，没有漂移 μ。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s formula rests on chapter 5’s geometric Brownian motion; only the band’s width σ enters it, not the drift μ.

label.en: The tree converges to the formula

reason.zh: 第 6 章的公式算出的价格，就是第 4 章的树在步数增多时一上一下靠近的那条横线。
reason.en: The price chapter 6’s formula gives is the line that chapter 4’s tree zigzags towards as the steps increase.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的 Δ、Γ、Vega、Θ 是第 6 章公式对股价、波动率和时间的偏导；方程里的 ∂²V/∂S² 就是 Γ。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s Δ, Γ, Vega and Θ are the partial derivatives of chapter 6’s formula in price, volatility and time; the equation’s ∂²V/∂S² is Γ.

reason.zh: 第 8 章：公式里只有 σ 看不见，拿市场价倒推出的 σ 就是隐含波动率，它随行权价变就是微笑。
reason.en: Chapter 8: σ is the only unobservable input, so the σ that reproduces a market price is the implied volatility; its change across strikes is the smile.

reason.zh: 第 9 章让波动率自己随机变化、并和股价负相关，长出和第 8 章真实数据方向一样的偏斜。
reason.en: Chapter 9 lets volatility move randomly and against the price, which grows a skew in the same direction as chapter 8’s market data.

reason.zh: 第 9 章：第 1 章的套利假设对手到期一定付钱；每日结算的保证金和清算所就是为这个前提建的。
reason.en: Chapter 9: chapter 1’s arbitrage assumes the other side pays at expiry; daily margin and the clearing house exist to make that true.

label.en: Option buyers pay Θ every day

reason.zh: 第 10 章解释散户为什么亏时用了第 7 章的机制：买期权每天付出 Θ，只有真实波动超过价格里含的波动才补得回来。
reason.en: Chapter 10 explains retail losses with chapter 7’s mechanism: an option buyer pays Θ daily and wins it back only if realised volatility beats the implied.

label.en: A deposit, or the whole stake

reason.zh: 第 10 章：对有现货的农场，第 9 章的保证金只是押金；对没有现货的人，那个账户就是全部，小幅波动就能输光。
reason.en: Chapter 10: for a farm holding the crop, chapter 9’s margin is only a deposit; for someone without it, that account is everything and a small move can wipe it out.

reason.zh: F = S·e^((r−q)T)：远期价是现货按利率复利到期、再扣掉持有期收益，与折现是同一个计算的两个方向。
reason.en: F = S·e^((r−q)T): the forward is the spot compounded at the rate, less what the asset yields; it is discounting run forwards.

reason.zh: 第 1 章的持有成本公式用连续复利写成 e^((r−q)T)，并链到指数与对数一课。
reason.en: Chapter 1 writes the cost of carry with continuous compounding, e^((r−q)T), and links the exponents and logarithms lesson.

reason.zh: 第 2 章：看涨、看跌、股票和存款四样里任意三样能拼出第四样；股票和存款（债券）是先要懂的两样。
reason.en: Chapter 2: any three of call, put, share and deposit make the fourth; the share and the deposit (a bond) are the two to understand first.

reason.zh: 第 3 章的复制成本可以写成“按风险中性概率求期望再折现”；那个概率不是真实的上涨概率。
reason.en: Chapter 3’s replication cost can be written as an expectation under risk-neutral probabilities, discounted; those are not the real odds of a rise.

reason.zh: 第 4 章的树走 N 步、终点数目服从二项分布；第 5 章引二项分布与正态一课说明它怎样趋向钟形。
reason.en: The ending nodes of chapter 4’s N-step tree are binomially distributed; chapter 5 links the binomial-to-normal lesson to show how this becomes a bell curve.

reason.zh: 第 5 章：N 步之后对数股价是 N 个独立小随机数之和，按中心极限定理趋向标准差 σ√T 的正态分布。
reason.en: Chapter 5: after N steps the log price is a sum of N independent small shocks, which the central limit theorem turns into a normal with standard deviation σ√T.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的赫斯顿模型没有布莱克–斯科尔斯那样的简单公式，直接生成两万条路径求平均再折现。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s Heston model has no Black–Scholes-style formula, so the page simulates twenty thousand paths, averages and discounts.

label.zh: 每个希腊字母都是导数

reason.zh: Δ = ∂V/∂S、Γ = ∂²V/∂S²：第 6、7 章用导数“此刻的变化率”的意思读这些量，并链到导数一课。
reason.en: Δ = ∂V/∂S and Γ = ∂²V/∂S²: chapters 6 and 7 read them as instantaneous rates of change and link the derivative lesson.

label.en: Another way to quote a price

reason.zh: 第 8 章：隐含波动率是期权报价的另一种写法，就像债券价格可以换算成收益率，并链到利率与债券一课。
reason.en: Chapter 8: implied volatility is another way to write an option’s price, as a bond’s price can be written as a yield; it links the rates and bonds lesson.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的 LTCM：头寸按历史数据是分散的，1998 年危机里原本不相关的东西一起动了；链到分散化一课讲的相关性。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s LTCM: positions diversified on historical data all moved together in the 1998 crisis; it links the diversification lesson on correlation.

label.en: Pooling risk versus passing it on

reason.zh: 第 10 章说同一份合约对有现货风险的人是保险：风险池化靠把很多独立风险合在一起变小，套期保值则是把一种风险交给对手方。
reason.en: Chapter 10 calls the contract insurance for whoever holds the physical risk: pooling shrinks many independent risks by combining them, a hedge hands one risk to a counterparty.
